title: Printed Long Take — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Long take across the plate
scenes.purpose: A carved light trace on a dark, fixed engraving plate travels from a single seed to a connected system while the viewport advances in one uninterrupted move across changing hatch density.
visuals: Dark ink surround (#15120F) with a fixed 1160x480 viewport onto a 1440-unit registered plate (#1F1A15), panned about 280 px
Seeded, softened engraving texture: 28 pt stipple (I), 35-degree line hatch narrowing from 20 to 14 (II), crosshatch mesh 14 to 11 (III)
Cream carved trace (#EADBC0) with offset shadow cut; landmark rings pop as it passes
Small red accent (#C0463A) only on the hub and its dashed registration line
Zone labels printed under the plate, registered to it; fixed caption on clean ink

beats.development: The camera starts moving at once across the seed stipple; the trace cuts out from the start node and the caption fades up on clean ink. The camera lingers around 0.95 s as the stipple gives way to line hatching.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: The camera returns to its steady rate across the narrowing line hatch, bringing the crosshatch mesh into the frame. Landmark nodes appear along the trace as it passes.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: The camera comes to rest at 2.3 s as the trace reaches the red hub and registration line. Links grow outward into a four-node mesh, fully settled by 2.62 s, then everything holds.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Single uninterrupted camera move (about 280 px, under about 5 px per frame) with a deliberate linger at the stipple-to-line change and an ease onto the hub; no cuts or viewport resets.
Caption fully legible from 0.6 s on a solid ink band outside the engraved field.
justifiedHolds: 2.62-3.0 s settled hold on the completed connected system and caption.

notes: All canvas state is derived from GSAP timeline time through a setter-driven time driver; hf-seek redraws from tl.time(). Texture and stipple jitter are cached once with seed 183.
No preview recipes supplied; demonstrates the primary characteristic action.
